name: animeinfo
description: Gets the information of the specified anime.

name: avatar
description: Gets the avatar of the specified user.

name: botinfo
description: Gets the information of the bot.

name: changelog
description: Gets the latest changelog of the bot.

name: channelinfo
description: Gets the information of the specified or current channel.

name: corona
description: Gets the current status on the world or on the specified country of the current pandemic.

name: help
description: Gives you the info of the specified command or the full list of commands.

name: mclookup
description: Gets the info of the minecraft player found by the name or uid given.

name: ping
description: Gets the latency of the bot.

name: pingme
description: Gives or removes you the PingMe role that is used by the staff to give less important announcements.

name: poll
description: Creates a poll about the topic specified.

name: remind
description: The bot will remind you the specified message in the duration given.

name: roleinfo
description: Gets the info of the specified role.

name: rover
description: Gets the information of the specified user's linked roblox account.

name: serverinfo
description: Gets the info of the current guild.

name: whois
description: Gets the information of the specified user.
